## Scope

The audit examined the quality of grading through a repeat review of graded sets. A sample of 438 graded sets was read again by a second grader. The purpose of the repeat reading was to compare the original grading decision with the second grader’s assessment and identify the level of agreement between the two grades.

## Result

The first and second grades agreed in 64.4 per cent of sets. This result indicates the overall level of agreement observed in the sample reviewed for the audit. It should be considered alongside the detailed results for individual graders.

Per-grader results are recorded in the attached spreadsheet. These results are discussed with each grader privately to support review of the findings and any follow-up required.
